title: 你中文好可爱

series.next: In the kitchen, 大姑 is cornering your mum: she wants to know exactly what you do for a living.

setting: Grandma's courtyard, Saturday lunch: twelve relatives, three neighbours, twenty dishes.

nainai.name: 奶奶
nainai.en: your grandma, turning eighty: feeds everyone, cries easily (happily)

dagu.name: 大姑
dagu.en: your dad's eldest sister, filming everything for the family group

eryi.name: 二姨
eryi.en: your mum's second sister: the family matchmaker, who says what she sees

biaoge.name: 表哥
biaoge.en: your cousin, 大姑's son: never stops talking

wangdaye.name: 王大爷
wangdaye.en: the neighbour from across the lane, here for the food and the show

doudou.name: 豆豆
doudou.en: your little cousin, six: a chopstick expert

steps.zh: 来来来，快叫人！我录视频发群里！
steps.en: Come on, come on, say hello to everyone! I'm filming this for the family group!

say.en: Greet the table properly: Grandma first, then everyone.
say.tip: 叫人 jiào rén = greet everyone properly, eldest first: 奶奶好, then 大家好.

miss.en: Never mind the hellos. You're home, that's what counts!

answers: 奶奶好！大家好！想死你们了！
奶奶好，大家好，我想死你们了！
奶奶好！大家好！可想死你们了！
3.en: Greet Grandma, then everyone, and tell them how much you've missed them.
3.gloss: Hi, Grandma! Hi, everyone! I've missed you all so much!
3.tip: 想死你们了 = I've missed you to death: the big, warm hello, arms wide open.

steps.zh: 哎哟，你中文好可爱！再说两句！
steps.en: Aww, your Chinese is so cute! Say some more!

say.en: Your Chinese is 'cute'? Say you learned it from Grandma, and let her take the bow.
answers: 我的中文是跟奶奶学的！
我的中文都是跟奶奶学的！
say.gloss: I learned my Chinese from Grandma!
say.tip: 是……的 puts the spotlight on who: 是跟奶奶学的 = it was Grandma I learned it from. 跟……学 = learn from.

ok.zh: 听见没？跟我学的！每周视频，一句一句教的！
ok.en: Hear that? Learned it from me! Every week on video, line by line!

miss.en: Cute, isn't it? Learned it from me!

answers: 跟奶奶学的中文，能不可爱吗？
跟奶奶学的中文，当然可爱！
中文是跟奶奶学的，能不可爱吗？
3.en: Turn it round: Chinese learned from Grandma, how could it not be cute?
3.gloss: Chinese learned from Grandma: how could it not be cute?
3.tip: 能不……吗？ = how could it not be...?: the rhetorical question that ends the argument.

steps.en: Can you use chopsticks? I can!

say.en: Your six-year-old cousin wants to know if you can use chopsticks. You've used them since you were little.
say.gloss: I've used them since I was little!

not.note: 不会 says you can't! You can: 我从小就用.

say.tip: 从小 cóngxiǎo = since childhood: 我从小就用 = I've used them since I was little.

ok.zh: 哟！那夹个花生给大家看看！
ok.en: Oh ho! Let's see you pick up a peanut, then!

ok.narr: One peanut, clean as you like. The table cheers. 🥜

fail.en: So can you or can't you?

miss.zh: 当然会！筷子也是跟我学的！
miss.en: Of course they can! Learned that from me too!

1.en: Your six-year-old cousin asks if you can use chopsticks. Of course you can!

answers: 从小就用，花生都能夹起来！
我从小就用，夹花生都没问题！
从小用到大，夹花生都不掉！
3.en: Since you were little, and you can even pick up peanuts. Say so.
3.gloss: Since I was little. I can even pick up peanuts!
3.tip: 都能…… = can even...: 花生都能夹起来 = I can even pick up peanuts, the classic chopstick test.

steps.zh: 瘦了瘦了！在外面是不是没好好吃饭？
steps.en: So thin! You're not eating properly over there, are you?

steps.zh: 哪儿瘦了？我看是胖了！脸都圆了！
steps.en: Thin? Looks to me like you've put some on! Your face is all round!

say.en: 二姨 says you've put on weight. Deflect: Grandma's cooking is just too good.
answers: 都是奶奶做的菜太好吃！
say.gloss: Grandma's cooking is just too good!
say.tip: 奶奶做的菜 = the food Grandma makes: 的 turns 奶奶做 into a description. Credit the cook and she'll forgive anything.

ok.zh: 好吃就多吃！来，再吃个鸡腿！
ok.en: If it's good, eat more! Here, have another drumstick!
Alright, alright. Eat up, eat up!

fail.zh: 你看，不说话了，肯定胖了！
fail.en: See? Gone quiet. Definitely put some on!

miss.en: Weight, nonsense! Here, have a drumstick!

answers: 都怪奶奶，做的菜太好吃了！
没办法，奶奶做的菜太好吃了！
怪奶奶，她做的菜太好吃了！
3.en: 二姨 says you've put on weight. Blame Grandma's cooking.
3.gloss: Blame Grandma: her cooking's too good!
3.tip: 都怪…… = it's all ...'s fault: blame the cook, and the cook is delighted.

steps.zh: 别光吃了！来，给大家表演一个！
steps.en: Enough eating! Come on, do a turn for everyone!

say.en: The table wants a show. Offer to sing a song.
say.tip: 首 shǒu counts songs and poems: 唱首歌 = sing a song. 吧 makes it an offer.

then.narr: Your joke: a polar bear plucks out all his fur, then says: 'So cold!' 🐻‍❄️
then.zh: 一只北极熊把毛全拔光了，说：好冷啊！

then.en: Hahaha... so cold! Tell it again!
You tell it six more times. Grandma laughs till she cries, every single time. 😂
then.zh: 你又讲了六遍，奶奶每次都笑出了眼泪。

fail.zh: 大声点！唱歌还是讲笑话？
fail.en: Louder! A song, or a joke?

miss.en: No show? Then you're on dish duty!
Twenty dishes, fifteen people, one sink. They sing without you. 🍽️
miss.zh: 二十个盘子，一个水池。大家唱歌，你洗碗。

answers: 献丑了，我给大家唱首歌！
那我就献个丑，唱一首吧！
3.en: The table wants a show. Humbly offer a song.
3.gloss: Then I'll embarrass myself with a song!
3.tip: 献丑了 xiànchǒu le = (I'll) show off my lack of talent: the humble thing to say before you perform.

answers: 我五音不全，讲个笑话吧！
唱歌就算了，我讲个笑话吧！
alts.gloss: I'm tone-deaf, so here's a joke instead!

steps.narr: You sing 'The Moon Represents My Heart'. By line two, all fifteen join in. Off key. Loud. 🌕
steps.zh: 你唱起了《月亮代表我的心》，全桌都跟着唱，调全跑了。
唱得真好！奶奶都听哭了！
steps.en: So beautiful! You've made Grandma cry!
Twenty dishes, fifteen voices, not one in key. 大姑 posts the video: the family group has it in a minute, in four time zones. 🌕
steps.zh: 一分钟后，四个时区的亲戚都看到了。
